import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int K = 105;
    static final int Mod = 1000000007;
    static long n;
    static int k;

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] a;

        Matrix() {
            a = new int[K + 2][K + 2];
        }

        void unit(int len) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
                a[i][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        void out() {
            for (int i = 1; i <= k + 1; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k + 1; j++) {
                    System.out.print(a[i][j] + (j == k + 1 ? "\n" : " "));
                }
            }
            System.out.println();
        }
    }

    static int id(int x, int step) {
        if (x <= k) {
            return ((x + step - 1) % k + 1);
        } else {
            return x;
        }
    }

    static Matrix move(Matrix base, int step) {
        step %= k;
        Matrix res = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 1; i <= k + 1; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= k + 1; j++) {
                res.a[id(i, step)][id(j, step)] = base.a[i][j];
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static Matrix multiply(Matrix lhs, Matrix rhs) {
        Matrix res = new Matrix();
        int cur = k + 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= cur; i++) {
            for (int kIdx = 1; kIdx <= cur; kIdx++) {
                if (lhs.a[i][kIdx] != 0) {
                    for (int j = 1; j <= cur; j++) {
                        res.a[i][j] = (int)((res.a[i][j] + 1L * lhs.a[i][kIdx] * rhs.a[kIdx][j]) % Mod);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextInt();

        Matrix[] A = new Matrix[K + 2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= k + 1; i++) {
            A[i] = new Matrix();
        }

        int[] ans = new int[K + 2];

        A[0].unit(k + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= k + 1; i++) {
            A[0].a[1][i] = 1;
        }

        int[] V = new int[64];
        int VSize = 0;
        long tempN = n;
        while (tempN > 0) {
            V[VSize++] = (int)(tempN % k);
            tempN /= k;
        }

        int len = 0;
        A[0].unit(k + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= k + 1; i++) {
            A[0].a[1][i] = 1;
        }

        for (int idx = 0; idx < VSize; idx++) {
            int cur = V[idx];
            if (cur != 0) {
                int p = 0;
                Matrix x = A[len];
                A[++len] = new Matrix();
                A[len].unit(k + 1);
                long power = k;
                long pVal = 0;
                while (power > 0) {
                    if ((power & 1) != 0) {
                        A[len] = multiply(A[len], move(x, (int)((1 ^ 1) << p)));
                    }
                    x = multiply(move(x, 1 << p), x);
                    p++;
                    power >>= 1;
                }
                for (int times = 0; times < cur; times++) {
                    int[] tmp = new int[K + 2];
                    System.arraycopy(ans, 0, tmp, 0, ans.length);
                    Matrix B = move(A[idx], times + 0);
                    for (int i = 1; i <= k + 1; i++) {
                        for (int j = 1; j <= k + 1; j++) {
                            ans[i] = (int)((ans[i] + 1L * tmp[j] * B.a[i][j]) % Mod);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k + 1; i++) {
            res = (res + ans[i]) % Mod;
        }
        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }
}
